newsitem.title: MOROCCO: French fund to grant $24 mln to Moroccan banks.
newsitem.headline: French fund to grant $24 mln to Moroccan banks.

text.p: France's Proparco fund will grant loans totalling 142 million Francs ($24 million) to three Moroccan banks to finance development projects, the official news agency MAP said on Wednesday.
Proparco will devote 100 million francs to Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur which will become the first Moroccan bank to benefit from loans reserved to most efficient banks, it said.

Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique will get 30 million francs for a credit to Eucaforest, which produces eucalyptus wood for Morocco's only manufacturer of paper pulp, Cellulose du Maroc.
The remainder will go to Wafabank to help a textile factory in the central city of Fez resume operations.
